title: native frame relay without JS pixel readback

definition.title: native frame relay without JS pixel readback
definition.source_excerpt: The source video used native <video> decoding. captureStream() supplied a video track; MediaStreamTrackProcessor exposed VideoFrame objects; a pass-through TransformStream forwarded the frames unchanged to MediaStreamTrackGenerator; a second <video> rendered the generated track. Over ~2.2 s, 67 frames entered the transform and 66 were presented by the second video. Both tracks remained live, the destination had readyState=4, and neither media element reported an error. There was no canvas draw, VideoFrame.copyTo(), pixel array, encoder, or compressed re-mux in the relay path. This proves an application-visible native-frame routing primitive; it does not prove zero-copy inside the browser/GPU implementation.
